cases.title: curl / libcurl 8.3.0

checks.name: SOCKS5 heap buffer overflow
checks.reason: SOCKS5 remote DNS, hostname/buffer length and handshake conditions matter.

checks.name: Cookie injection via duplicated handle
checks.reason: Library API path; not accessible through the curl CLI.

checks.name: Mixed-case cookie PSL bypass
checks.reason: Still affected in 8.4.0. Inspect cookie use and PSL support.

checks.name: Unbounded response-header memory
checks.reason: Both selected releases contain this earlier fix.

cases.triage: Source inventory does not establish a running application. For CVE-2023-38545, the CLI default 100 KiB buffer prevents the heap overflow, but a low --limit-rate can reduce it below 65,541 bytes. The advisory also documents another hostname-length consequence even with a larger buffer. Do not label the whole CVE harmless from buffer size alone.
cases.expected_change: 8.3.0 to 8.4.0 fixes CVE-2023-38545 and CVE-2023-38546. CVE-2023-46218 must remain a finding.

cases.title: OpenSSL 1.0.1f / s_server

checks.name: Heartbleed memory disclosure
checks.reason: Heartbeat support and the actual loaded library matter.

checks.name: CCS man-in-the-middle weakness
checks.reason: Both client and server must be vulnerable; both tested releases precede the fix.

checks.name: DTLS fragment buffer overflow
checks.reason: Requires DTLS use. TLS-only operation does not exercise this path.

cases.triage: Confirm the actual TLS library and build flags, including OPENSSL_NO_HEARTBEATS. Source-only scans cannot establish deployed reachability. Keep DTLS-specific conditions separate from TLS server operation.
cases.expected_change: 1.0.1f to 1.0.1g fixes Heartbleed. The two June 2014 CVEs remain affected at the component-version level.

cases.title: Struts 2.5.12 / full libraries

checks.name: Namespace handling / RCE
checks.reason: Check namespace and alwaysSelectFullNamespace configuration.

checks.name: File upload path traversal
checks.reason: Runtime applicability requires the affected file upload path.

checks.name: REST XML deserialization / RCE
checks.reason: REST plugin present in the full ZIP; absent from the minimum ZIPs.

cases.triage: The full 2.5.12 ZIP contains 93 JARs, including REST plugin 2.5.12 and XStream 1.4.8. Each minimum ZIP contains 8 JARs without REST plugin. These counts were independently obtained from official ZIP entries. Plugin presence does not prove XML endpoints or vulnerable application configuration.
cases.expected_change: 2.5.12 minimum: two named core findings, no REST-plugin finding. 2.5.33 minimum: none of these three named CVEs should be active; other CVEs are outside this selected baseline.

cases.title: Example web application 1.0.0 / SBOM

checks.name: HTML injection / XSS
checks.reason: jQuery 3.4.0 is within the public affected range.

cases.triage: The internal-device-agent has no public identity or versioned Package URL in the supplied SBOM. Preserve it in the inventory and label vulnerability coverage unresolved / not scanned. Do not infer that it has zero vulnerabilities. No runtime use of jQuery is established by the SBOM.
cases.expected_change: New input in the pulled update. Verify both components are retained, jQuery is matched, and the unidentified component is visibly not scanned.
